built_by: WP1 studio merge (R2 rig + knees, studio walk and transitions, WP2 gestures, WP5 mouth mesh)

viseme_mesh_gain.meaning: No gain is baked into this mesh. The R2 baked x1.5 on E, I, kk, DD and nn is NOT applied: WP5 replaced those shape keys. Use the V2 gains and caps (the runtime picks them from the browUp morph): closures PP FF SS cap 1.0, aa O U gain 1.0 cap 1.0, E I DD kk CH RR gain 1.0 cap 1.2, nn gain 1.0 cap 1.2 (WP5 fix round 2). Viseme weights must sum to at most 1.0. V1 web gains (E 1.8, I 1.5, kk 1.5, DD 1.5, nn 2.0) would over-drive this mesh.
viseme_mesh_gain.viseme_set_version_note: viseme_set_version 2 (WP5). Ship rule: this GLB ships only with a runtime that has the V2 gain switch (hk/06-mouth-acting).

prop_L.offset_space: local space of the parent joint node, metres
prop_L.purpose: hologram anchor; reusable for held props
prop_L.palm_up_note: with the forearm supinated palm-up (CONTACTS palm_up) the socket sits 5 cm above the palm centre

forearms.elbow_flex: rz on the forearm node; left negative, right positive, 0..120 degrees; forearm swings forward

clips.name: Idle
clips.meaning: I'm here, calm and alive.
clips.note: constant offset so that f0 == legacy R2 Idle f0 (see p2_rehome_idle.py)
clips.entry_note: SPEC 4 'running': keep the clock when this loop becomes the base; entry_s is not used

clips.name: LookAround
clips.meaning: Looking at the world.
clips.note: constant offset so that f0 == legacy R2 Idle f0 (see p2_rehome_idle.py)
clips.marker_note: P2 names (turn1 14, turn2 58, return 106) are canonical; the R2 names (turnL 14, turnR 59, home 126) stay as aliases so v1 callers keep working. The aliases point to the P2 frames.

clips.name: Walk
clips.entry_note: SPEC 4 'running': keep the clock when this loop becomes the base; entry_s is not used
clips.meaning: In-place studio walk with knees, 16 frames, rolling planted feet, 0.28 m per cycle (two steps). Travel by moving the avatar at 0.525 m/s while it plays.
clips.home_note: a loop; Walk_Stop_R / Walk_Stop_L bring it back to Idle

clips.name: Walk_Start
clips.meaning: Idle to Walk: lean, the right foot lifts at f4, the root accelerates, ends on Walk f0 (right heel strike). Starts on Idle f0.
clips.root_speed_note: N+1 entries, m/s over interval i (f_i to f_i+1), the last entry (0.525) is the Walk speed it hands over to. Integrate with dt 1/30 for the travel.

clips.name: Walk_Stop_R
clips.meaning: Walk to Idle from a right heel strike (Walk f0, f16): decelerates, the feet close, settles to Idle f0.
clips.root_speed_note: N+1 entries, m/s per interval; first entry about 0.488 (Walk speed on entry), last 0 (Idle).

clips.name: Walk_Stop_L
clips.meaning: Walk to Idle from a left heel strike (Walk f8): mirror of Walk_Stop_R. Starts on Walk f8.
clips.root_speed_note: N+1 entries, m/s per interval; first entry about the Walk speed on entry, last 0 (Idle).

clip_rules.note: A channel is dropped only if it sits at the node rest value in every clip; channels at rest in one clip but animated in another are kept so crossfades return to rest. Beat_R, Beat_L, Beat_Both are additive and own arms, chest, head and neck only. Walk, Walk_Start and Walk_Stop_* also key shin_L and shin_R.

knee_bones.axis: rx on the shin node, positive = the shin folds backward (knee flexion), 0 to about 75 degrees

home_policy.rule: Every one-shot ends on Idle frame 0 (SearchStart and SearchSwipe on SearchHold frame 0); SearchSwipe and Found start on SearchHold frame 0. Verified at 1e-4 by the audit.
home_policy.walk_transitions: Walk_Start starts on Idle f0 and ends on Walk f0. Walk_Stop_R starts on Walk f0 (or f16) and ends on Idle f0. Walk_Stop_L starts on Walk f8 and ends on Idle f0.

walk.step_note: stride_m_per_cycle is the travel per 16 f cycle (two steps, so 0.14 m per step): 0.525 m/s x 0.5333 s = 0.28 m
walk.gait: rolling no-slip sole contact on the probed sole profile, knees (shin_L / shin_R), 16 f cycle, heel strike R at f0 and L at f8, compass-gait hip bob

stop_rules.stop_R: start Walk_Stop_R at a right heel strike (Walk phase 0 or 16)
stop_rules.stop_L: start Walk_Stop_L at a left heel strike (Walk phase 8)
stop_rules.note: Pick the stop whose start phase is the nearest following contact (at most 8 frames, 0.27 s, away), keep playing Walk until then, then crossfade-free switch (the clips start on the exact Walk pose).

walk.horizontal_foot_skate_mm: measured on the mesh: see HANDOFF-P1.md W2
known_limits: knee chart (R 15,22,28,20,12,7,5,12,22,32,40,52,60,45,28,14, L shifted 8 f) steps up to 15 deg per frame in Walk; the Start and Stop toe-offs step 18 deg (shin_R f5)
W6 knee targets: contact 16.4 / 12.4, down 28.6 / 27.0, swing max 57.4 / 56.7 (all inside the Bible 8.1 windows)

W7 seam: the strict 60 deg/s reading is infeasible at 16 f for knees and feet, see HANDOFF-P1.md; every junction is inside 1.05x the bone's own interior second difference (Walk_Start to Walk: shin_R 313 deg/s, worst bone ratio 0.91)
Idle f0 and every non-walk clip that starts or ends on Idle carry a soft knee layer (R 4.5 / L 4.0 deg, hips 0.16 mm lower); Blink, Nod and the Beat clips are partial or additive and own no leg bones

WP2 knees: Idle unloads the right knee (8 deg over the soft 4.5, f20-50) and the left (10 over 4.0, f125-160), so the shin peaks are 12.5 / 14.0 deg; Happy, Celebrate and Listen_Excited have knee forks (peaks 38.6 / 41 / about 18 deg before the soft layer). The layer moves the planted feet by at most 1.5 mm.
walk.note: Clip is in place. To travel, move the avatar along +Z (its facing direction in glTF) at 0.525 m/s while Walk plays.

pose_notes: Bind pose is a T-pose. The relaxed arm pose is carried inside every clip, so play a clip (Idle by default) before showing the avatar.

validator.note: gltf-validator; the one warning is NODE_SKINNED_MESH_NON_ROOT (head mesh under the Armature node), harmless in three.js. No MouthBag since WP5 round 1.

morph_targets_note: Avatar_lowpoly carries 20 targets (14 visemes sil PP FF DD kk CH SS nn RR aa E I O U, then browUp browInnerUp browDown cheekPuff mouthSmile PP_jaw). There is NO MouthBag mesh any more (WP5 fix round 1 removed it: its tongue showed as a pink line over the painted mouth interior).

mouth_bag.runtime_rule: No MouthBag in this GLB. lipsync/morphTargets.js binds every mesh that has the morph names, so nothing has to change; a runtime that still expects a second mesh with 14 targets must treat it as optional.

pp_jaw.rule: PP_jaw weight = PP weight * min(jaw, 0.2) / 0.2 (jaw in rad, the jaw bone's unit). It keeps the lip seal closed while the jaw opens up to 0.2 (HANDOFF-P5 / P5-READY.json). Fallback when the runtime cannot drive it: ppJawV2 = 0.0.

seam_weld.rule: vertices whose Basis positions match within 1e-5 share the averaged vertex-group weights (top 4, normalised); m_chin.py ran afterwards, the chin vertices keep no Bone.014 weight
seam_weld.proof: node tools/R2/review/seam_weights.mjs on this GLB: 0 mismatched pairs on every bone (the previous studio GLB had 580, 73 of them on leg bones); details in 02-working/P1/merge/weld-report.json
